map.AQL抽样方案查表与判定 使用指南: AQL Sampling Plan Lookup and Judgment User Guide
map.AQL 抽样方案查表与判定工具依据接收质量限查标准抽样方案并给出接收/拒收判定，: The AQL sampling plan lookup and judgment tool consults standard sampling plans by acceptance quality limit and gives an accept/reject verdict, suitable for defining sampling plans for incoming and outgoing inspection.
map.在quality场景里，先统一 Table Sampling 的输入口径，再输出: In a quality context, first unify the input scope of Table Sampling, then output a reusable structure for quick reconciliation and review.
map.当同类任务需要批量处理时，可用该工具做第一轮标准化；结果异常时再回到人工复核环节: When similar tasks must be processed in bulk, use this tool for a first round of standardization; if results look abnormal, go back to manual review to reduce the miss rate.
map.在业务流程中，先做小样本试算再扩展规模，能快速验证参数假设是否与实际口径一致。: In a business process, running a small pilot before scaling up quickly verifies whether the parameter assumptions match the real scope.
map.：先准备一组典型样本并固定单位与格式，运行一次并记录输出；再切换到边界样本（含缺: : first prepare a typical sample set and fix the units and format, run it once and record the output; then switch to boundary samples (with missing items and outliers) to see whether the results stay explainable, so a reproducible analysis checklist emerges.

map.这个 quality 工具适合什么阶段使用？: At What Stage Is This Quality Tool Best Used?
map.适合需求澄清和第一轮评估阶段；输出可直接用于方案讨论、初筛与结果复核，但关键决策: It suits requirement clarification and a first round of assessment; the output can be used directly for discussing options, shortlisting, and reviewing results, but key decisions should still be confirmed against historical strategy.
map.如何减少误用导致的偏差？: How Can Misuse-Induced Bias Be Reduced?
map.建议固定输入单位、统一日期范围，并与对照样本比对；如出现明显偏移，优先核查原始数: Fix the input units, use a consistent date range, and compare against a control sample; if a clear offset appears, check the raw data cleaning rules first.
